subject: pe
title: Applications: Fitness Tests
welcome_lead: Test the components — meet the GCSE fitness test battery.
meta_desc: GCSE PE Components of Fitness tests: Cooper run, sit and reach, vertical jump and more.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now match every test to the component it measures.

concepts.def: Runs as far as possible in 12 mins — CV endurance.
Test of lower back and hamstring flexibility.
Heaviest weight lifted once — strength test.
Sit-ups in one minute — muscular endurance.
Sargent jump test for leg power.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Match the test to the component:

  • Cooper 12-min / multi-stage fitness → CV endurance
  • Sit-up bleep → muscular endurance
  • Handgrip dynamometer / 1RM → strength
  • Sit and reach → flexibility
  • BMI / skinfolds → body composition

Illinois agility for agility, stork stand for balance, three-ball juggle or alternate-hand throw for coordination, vertical (Sargent) jump for power, ruler drop for reaction time, 30 m sprint for speed.
Tests must be reliable (same result repeated), valid (measures what it claims) and practical (cheap, easy). Always standardise warm-up, equipment and protocol so results can be compared.
